earnings.title: EX-99.1 PRESS RELEASE DATED OCTOBER 28, 2026
highlights: Record annual net revenues of $15.79 billion, record net income available to common shareholders of $2.37 billion, and record earnings per diluted share of $11.91 for fiscal 2026

(NYSE: RJF) today reported net revenues of $4.27 billion and net income available to common shareholders of $666 million, or $3.40 per diluted share, for the fiscal fourth quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Quarterly adjusted net income available to common shareholders, which excluded $37 million of acquisition-related expenses, net of tax, was $703 million (1) , or $3.59 per diluted share (1) .
Returned approximately $1.7 billion of capital to shareholders through the combination of common share repurchases and dividends paid in fiscal 2026
Record quarterly net revenues of $4.27 billion, up 15% over the prior year’s fiscal fourth quarter and 9% over the preceding quarter

quotes.text: We delivered our sixth consecutive year of record annual revenues and earnings, a testament to our resilient, diversified businesses anchored by our Private Client Group.
